description: Recurring-job hook: for each Azure handler, detect the billing agreement type and download the negotiated Azure Price Sheet (EA download-by-billing-account / MCA download-by-billing-profile) using the handler service principal, caching it on disk by meterId for the Azure rate hook. Skips CSP/MOSP/no-access subscriptions (those use retail). Wired to the 'Azure Price Sheet Refresh' recurring job.
name: Azure Price Sheet Refresh
